subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great talking earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps to kick off the security review: 

- Objective: Confirm security/compliance requirements and finalize scope for Redwood’s hosted API + embeddings integration.
- Immediate asks from your side: stakeholder mapping (economic buyer, legal/procurement contact, security reviewer), systems in scope, and target review timeline.
- From Redwood: we’ll share an initial security questionnaire and a short SOC 2 summary (see attached). If it helps, we can also run a brief kickoff call with our security engineer.

Please confirm:
1) Who is the economic buyer (name + best email)?
2) Who will own the security questionnaire review?
3) Are there additional systems/services that must be in-scope (e.g., SSO, data residency, cloud accounts, log collection endpoints)?
4) Target decision date / contract timeline?

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_initial.pdf (lightweight intake), scope_matrix.csv (template to list systems).

Proposed timeline: 2–3 weeks for initial review + Q&A, then alignment on any evidence requests. If you need a faster turnaround we can prioritize but will likely need a short POA on evidence.

Thanks — happy to answer anything now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & scope clarification

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and a bit more color on our side: 

1) Economic buyer / Exec sponsor: Priya Shah (CFO) — priya.shah@fintechco.com. She’ll sign off on cost/contract once legal/procurement and security are comfortable.
2) Security reviewer: Jose Ramirez (Security Engineering) — jose.ramirez@fintechco.com (I’ve included him on the questionnaire we’ll send).
3) Legal / Procurement: Michael Chu (legal.ops@fintechco.com) owns contract redlines; procurement routing goes through Priya.
4) Systems in-scope: Primary scope is our production API that will call Redwood for text generation and embeddings (Payload includes customer PII that is hashed before sending). We also need SSO (Okta), audit logging (Splunk), and evidence of data residency controls for US regions.

Timeline: target vendor selection by July 15 (so ~3 weeks). We’d like a filled questionnaire and any SOC2 / ISO summaries this week if possible. I’ve attached our standard security questionnaire (FintechCo_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — please fill column A/B where applicable.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood explicitly state what systems/components are in scope for the hosted API offering (metadata, logs, backups, KMS/HSM usage)?
- Will you confirm if any customer data is stored persistently and, if so, where (regions)?

I’ve cc’d Priya for visibility.

Thanks — Alex

Monica / Vivek — FYI and request for help. FintechCo sent stakeholder mapping and their questionnaire. Key items to confirm:

- They want explicit scoping for hosted API (metadata, logs, backups, KMS/HSM) and confirmation on persistent storage + region(s).
- Timeline: target selection by July 15 (tight).
- Economic buyer is Priya Shah (CFO) — procurement/contract routing will go through her/legal.

Can you: 
1) Review the FintechCo questionnaire (attached) and highlight any high-effort evidence requests we should flag.
2) Confirm standard language for data residency and persistent storage for hosted offering (we usually state ephemeral cache + option for customer-configured retention; want the exact wording).
3) Suggest whether we should include a short kickoff call with Jose Ramirez (security) or just handle via questionnaire/Q&A.

I’ve attached FintechCo_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx and our initial intake (Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_initial.pdf). I can set up a 30-min sync Wed AM if helpful.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintechco.com>, Jose Ramirez <jose.ramirez@fintechco.com>, Michael Chu <legal.ops@fintechco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff & scope clarification

Alex / team — thanks for the mapping and the questionnaire. Per your ask, we filled the intake for the items we can answer quickly and attached: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_initial.pdf (filled), plus a scope_matrix.csv that lists what’s in/out for the hosted API.

High-level answers (summary):
- Persistent storage: Redwood’s hosted API does not persist customer request payloads by default. We persist minimal telemetry/usage metrics for billing and SLO monitoring (token counts, latency metrics) — these are stored in US regions (us-west-2 primary). Customers can opt-in to longer-term storage for caching/embeddings where required; those options are explicitly configurable per-account and use customer-configured keys (KMS).
- Logs & backups: Application logs are retained for 30 days by default (configurable under Dedicated/Private offerings). Backups of model artifacts are managed internally; customer data backups are only created when a customer enables persistent storage for embeddings.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS. We can discuss HSM integrations for Private deployments.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Attached files: Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_initial.pdf, scope_matrix.csv.
2) Monica (cc’d) will follow up on any evidence requests and propose supporting docs (SOC 2 summary, architecture diagram, encryption spec).
3) Can we schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with Jose + Monica this week? I’m available Wed 9–11am PT or Thu 1–3pm PT.

If that works I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda — goal: confirm scope, agree evidence list, and set a target date for the next deliverable.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
